# Daniela Clape

**Headline:** Founder and CEO at Xpeer Medical Education, Mentor for Health startups
**Current role:** Founder And CEO Xpeer Medical Education
**Location:** Barcelona, Catalonia, Spain
**Experience:** 22 years 9 months
**LinkedIn:** https://www.linkedin.com/in/danielaclape · 29,390 followers
**Description:** 🚀 Helping pharma engage physicians through accredited digital education that truly makes an impact. I'm passionate about bridging medical education, compliance, and engagement. Over the past years, I've helped pharmaceutical teams design and deliver EACCME-accredited digital CME programs that not only meet rigorous standards — but also capture the attention of busy physicians, and create lasting relationships between healthcare professionals and the pharma industry. I work at the intersection of: ✅ Medical Affairs: ensuring scientific rigor and educational relevance ✅ Digital Engagement: turning passive learning into meaningful interaction ✅ Regulatory Compliance: aligning with EACCME and ethical standards 💡 Whether you're building an HCP platform, launching a new therapy, or rethinking your CME strategy — I can help you transform medical education into a strategic engagement tool. Let’s raise the bar for what pharma can do in accredited education. 📩 Open to collaboration, speaking opportunities, and thought leadership projects. Feel free to connect or message me.
